campaign_name: Authentic Running Shoes Sale — Up to 80% Off
special_brief: Push our pre-loved running shoe inventory — genuine Nike and Asics, personally inspected and condition-graded, up to 80% off retail. Audience already understands the pre-loved/resale concept; push them to check their size and buy before that one-of-a-kind pair sells out. Reassure on authenticity (personally inspected, not counterfeit) since that is this audience's biggest hesitation.
